## Summary
- Reject string boolean regime flags (`enabled`, `cache`, `annualise_volatility`) so quoted YAML values like `"false"` cannot silently enable controls.
- Reject non-finite supplied `threshold` / `neutral_band` values and risk-off fund-count / target-vol modifiers instead of falling back to defaults.

## Test plan
- [x] `pytest tests/test_regime_annualise.py::test_regime_control_values_reject_non_finite_and_string_boolean`
- [x] `pytest tests/test_pipeline_optional_features.py::test_regime_overrides_reject_non_finite_modifiers`
- [x] Regime threshold/annualise regression suite

Closes #6025

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Added stricter validation for regime and risk-off configuration values.
  * Invalid boolean, non-numeric, non-finite, or non-positive settings now produce clear configuration errors.
  * Out-of-range fund-count multipliers continue to use the default value.
  * Omitted risk-off multipliers continue to use the standard fallback behavior.
  * Neutral-band values continue to be normalized to their absolute value.

* **Tests**
  * Expanded coverage for invalid and non-finite configuration inputs.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
title: fix(regimes): validate regime control booleans and finite numeric values (closes #6025)

- Stop swallowing `CoreConfigError` in `pipeline_runner` when `portfolio.max_turnover` contains an unrecognised regime key.
- Add end-to-end entrypoint test proving `run_from_config` rejects invalid mappings before universe selection/weighting.

## Test plan
- [x] `pytest tests/test_pipeline_entrypoints.py::test_run_from_config_rejects_invalid_regime_turnover_cap` passes
- [x] Test asserts selection stage is not reached when parsing fails
